blocks.text: Is chapter ne dikhaya ke daawa kaise do hypotheses banta hai, namoone ka data aur test statistic un mein kaise faisla karte hain, aur nateeja imandari se kaise pesh aur report karein. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 7 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Hypothesis
Population, surat-e-haal ya variables ke rishte ke baare mein qabil-e-test bayan
Hypothesis testing
Shumariyati tareeqa jo tay kare ke namoone ka data daawe ki tayeed ya radd ke liye kafi saboot deta hai ya nahi
Null hypothesis (H0)
Koi numayan farq, asar ya rishta nahi
Alternative hypothesis (H1 ya Ha)
Numayan farq, asar ya rishta hai
Test statistic
Faisle ke liye namoone se number, jaise z, t ya F
Critical region
Taqseem ka woh hissa jahan H0 radd hota
Significance level (alpha)
H0 sach hote hue use radd karne ka zyada se zyada imkaan; aam taur par 0.05
p-value
H0 sach ho to mushahida ya us se intehai nateeje ka imkaan
Decision rule
H0 radd karne ya na karne ka qaida, maslan p-value < alpha ho to radd
Data visualisation
Graphs, charts aur diagrams jo data pesh aur tashreeh mein madad karein
Bias
Jama, tajzie ya tashreeh par na-munsifana asar jo gumraah kare
Data ka akhlaqi istemal
Raazdari bachate hue imandari, insaf aur zimmedari se jama, tajzia aur report
Nataij ka abalagh
Asal hypothesis se jor kar nataij wazeh aur durust pesh karna

items: H0 banam H1; test statistic; critical region; alpha; p-value; p < alpha ho to radd.
Nataij dikhayein; bias se bachein; data akhlaqi tareeqe se; imandar reporting.
